## How to Play Collect Hole

Collect Hole is a fun and addictive single-player black hole game. Touch the screen and drag to move your black hole around the level. Swallow colorful geometric objects like cubes, cylinders, and spheres to grow bigger. Use the magnet bonus to attract nearby objects faster!
